fact_previews: Fast Robot Trader is an open-source algorithmic trading software that allows anyone to trade securities and invest in stocks.
Fast Robot Trader was created by Maple Intercontinental Trade Inc.
The software allows users to automate complex, quantitative trading strategies in forex, options, futures, stocks, ETFs, and commodities markets.
A downloadable SDK will be available for any developer who wants to work on the trading algorithm.
The project's funding goal was $141,228.
